# Minion Skill Level scaling

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, level-scaling

## Derived / confirmed formula

Effective level = base level + minion_skill_level (+ spirit_magi_skill_level). Above level 20 a compounding multiplier applies: x1.10 per level 21-30, x1.08 per level 31+ (coefficient + shared base plateau at the data max).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Mirrors the player above-max multiplier; confirm the 20-level cap + rates in-game.

## Implementation (engine model)

minion_offense.py reads minion_skill_level + spirit_magi_skill_level, computes effective_level, applies offense._above_max_mult(effective_level, 20) to the hit; sets OffenseResult.effective_level + above_max_mult.
